subject: C30
required_fixes: R1 — High: crates/desktop-core/src/authority.rs:3539 and authority/setup_domain.rs:855 bypass the guard at authority.rs:3615. Completing Add a tenant assigns data.active and retires the current context while a Harness approval can still be pending. This violates I1 and screens/shell.md, which explicitly includes wizard completion in the single guarded switch path. Route setup completion through the same native switch admission without committing or retiring the conversation prematurely. Acceptance: with a real pending approval, wizard completion publishes the guard and preserves the active tenant, draft and decision until Stay/Archive/Discard is resolved; test the production authority interface and native window flow.

R2 — High: crates/desktop-core/src/authority/harness_domain.rs:718 only cancels and retires the live conversation for Discard. It neither deletes its protected history nor disables its history sink. harness/session.rs:653 saves an interrupted pending turn through authority/harness_history.rs:719, whose admission does not check discard; earlier saved turns also remain. Thus the dialog's promise to drop the transcript and provenance P35's archive/discard distinction are false. Acceptance: after Discard and all asynchronous writers settle, the conversation is absent from saved-history listing/opening after switching back and relaunching; Archive retains readable history. Cover previously saved and first-turn-pending conversations, including a save racing with Discard.

R3 — High: crates/desktop-core/src/authority.rs:1716-1725 and authority/inbox_domain.rs:373 keep one context-bound overview and one global ReadBookkeeping, rather than tenant-owned read state. A→B→A creates a new context, so overview_view hides A's cached read and Inbox; generation/rechecking meanwhile carry across tenants. The Rust isolation test rereads A and therefore misses this loss, whereas the UI round-trip test supplies a cached snapshot the core does not produce. Acceptance: read and hold an item in A, switch to never-read B and back without another remote read; A's cached items/read time/selection remain, B stays independently pending, and pending recheck metadata never crosses tenants. Retired contexts must remain invalid.

R4 — High: crates/desktop-core/src/authority.rs:3633-3654 always dispatch ManagementRequest::Overview, including for recheckProduct, while authority/inbox_domain.rs:363 declares selected Red Team/model-skill products NotRead. This omits the finite reads of every selected admitted product required by screens/inbox-reads.md; P33 documents the reduction but does not implement that requirement. Additionally, Gateway with no workspace contributes no sourcesMissing, so home.tsx:23-28 reports an allowed 'all sources complete' or 'no activity' despite 0/2 Gateway sources read; reproduced with the production readLine function. Acceptance: selected-product reads and rechecks invoke their existing admitted services, settle finite per-product outcomes, and never announce complete/no activity for unread coverage. Add mixed-product, missing-workspace, denied and partial-source tests.

R5 — Medium: apps/desktop/src/v2/inbox/inbox.tsx:21 reduces an API-key action to navigate(administration), losing its target tab/resource. AdministrationView initializes to profiles (features/administration/administration-view.tsx:76), so 'Open API keys' opens profiles. setup_warning_item/warning_destination also send Red Team/model-skill warnings toward API keys. The new component test only asserts the broad navigate intent. Acceptance: clicking contextual actions from Home and Inbox selects the correct product/tab/resource in the destination; verify the resulting production view, including API-key and setup-warning items.

R6 — Medium: apps/desktop/src/v2/home.tsx and v2/inbox/inbox.tsx:107 discard dispatch outcomes for Read now, Recheck and Home hold actions. A scan-only tenant's refused Home read produces no warning or recovery state; an independent component probe returned capabilityMissing and observed only 'First read pending', with no toast or unconfirmed entry. Inbox hold actions show text but offer no required unknown-delivery retry. Acceptance: refused/failed/unknown outcomes for each new action receive the specified tenant-named feedback and explicit recovery, with no automatic replay; an admitted recheck also produces the specified observed info feedback.

R7 — Medium: apps/desktop/src/v2/v2-shell.tsx:74-104 shares seenTenant across two effects. The completion effect updates it before the snooze effect checks it, so a tenant change never establishes the intended independent snooze baseline. Switching to a snapshot containing an existing hold reproduced a 'B already snoozed snoozed · returns …' toast without a snooze dispatch; rereads can similarly rediscover existing holds. Acceptance: tenant switches and ordinary read refreshes do not announce old snoozes as new actions; a new snooze in the active tenant still announces its core-computed return time once.

R8 — Medium: apps/desktop/src/v2/inbox/inbox.tsx:127 fixes the two columns at minimum widths of 280px and 300px, with no narrow-width reflow. The supplied inbox-light-200.png and inbox-snoozed-light-200.png visibly clip the detail pane and its text beyond the window's right edge. This fails the required zoom/resizing usability. Acceptance: at the supported minimum window and 200% zoom in both themes, rows, detail text/facts and all actions remain reachable without horizontal clipping; retain native bounds/keyboard assertions and corrected screenshots.
